title: Particles at a glance (N5 review)
pattern: は が を に で へ の も と か
meaning_en: How the common particles divide the work.
explanation: は marks the topic, が marks the subject of existence, likes and skills, を marks an object, の links nouns, も means "also", と means "and" or "with", か makes a question.
に marks a place of existence, a time, or a person you meet; で marks the place of an action or the means; へ marks a destination.
A quick test: if the verb acts on a thing, use を; if it happens in a place, use で; if something exists in a place, use に.
structure_notes: Match each noun with the particle that shows its job in the sentence.
common_mistakes: Reading the particles は, へ, を as ha, he, wo.
